sectors.label: AI & Agents
sectors.rationale: AI remains the dominant equity theme (AI-linked >80% of S&P gains per Jefferies); crypto-side AI narratives (agentic economy, AI x DePIN) appear mostly in promotional posts, so crypto attention is uncertain.

sectors.label: Memecoins

sectors.label: Privacy
